expectations.text: A port interface for the Teams notifier is added to server/src/vendor/shared/adapters.ts (the shared ports file)
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: Port DigestNotifier in server/src/vendor/shared/adapters.ts.

expectations.text: The concrete webhook client (the HTTP call) lives in a new file in its own directory server/src/adapters/<name>/
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: Concrete fetch client in server/src/adapters/teams/.

expectations.text: A mock implementation of the port is added to server/src/adapters/mocks.ts
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: MockDigestNotifier class in server/src/adapters/mocks.ts.

expectations.text: server/src/platform/container.ts registers the adapter with an accessor and a ContainerOverrides entry so it can be replaced in tests
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: container.ts has ContainerOverrides plus an accessor reading TEAMS_WEBHOOK_URL.

expectations.text: DigestService calls the notifier only through this.container and has no fetch call or import of the concrete adapter
expectations.evidence: with_skill run-2: DigestService uses this.container accessor; no fetch, no adapter import.
